content: Leprawan gueshyag runata Jesús cuticächingan
Nä chay gotupita Jesús chrarparamuptinga achca achcam runacuna gatirapäcura.
Jinarcurmi gueri nirayag leprawan gueshyag runaga Jesuspa naupanman gongorpacuyur “Munayniyog tayta, munargar cuticayächilämay” nin.
Niptin Jesusga chacchayurmi yatayurun “Munayämi cuticänayta” nir. Chaura nir yatayurpuptilanmi chayüra gueshyanpita runaga cuticarun.

Chaura Jesusga “Amam pitas willapacunquichu cuticächingagta, antis ayway Diospa wayinchru cayag sacerdötiman, jinaman Moisés mandangannuy Diospag gonaycagta aparicuy chay gueshyapita nä cuticasha cangayta musyapäcunanpag” nirunmi.
Juc rantisha mözuta Jesús cuticächingan
Chaura Capernaum marcaman Jesús nä chraruptinmi, pachrac soldäducuna mandag Roma runaga Jesusman ashuyur
cay nirun: “Munayniyog tayta, wayïchrümi juc rantisha runä jitarayälan uncutucusha nanaywan alisca cunchuyar”.
Niptinmi Jesusga cay nin: “Cuticächinäpag noga aywashag”.
Chay niruptin runaga cay nirunmi: “Munayniyog tayta, nogaga manam maygan alinnin runas cächu wayïman yaycunaypagga. Antis caylachru niruy cuticänanpag, chaura rantisha runäga cuticarungam.

Nogasi mandagnïpa munayninchrümi cayä. Nätan nogapa munaynïchrüsi soldäducuna cayanmi. Juc soldädüta ‘Wacta ayway’ niptï aywanmi. Nätan jucta ‘Shamuy’ niptïsi shamunmi. Chaynuymi rantisha runäsi ‘Cayta ruray’ niptïsi ruran”.
Chay nigta mayarur Jesusga mayacasham ricacarun. Jinarcurmi gatirarcayag runacunata cay nirun: “Mayapäcamay shumag: Caynuy yupachicamag runataga manam Israel castacunachru ricarächu.

Caytas niyärishay: Achcam paynuysi mana Israel castacuna aywapäcamunga inti yargamunan lädupitas jinaman inti yaycunan lädupitas Diospa munayninchru Abrahamwan Isaacwan Jacobwan parëju tacuyur micapäcurcänanpag.
Nätan Israel castacunaga washa yanauyagmannuymi gargosha capäcunga. Chaychrümi alisca wagapäcunga, jinaman quiruncunatasi gapapayla cachrucurcanga ‘¡Imanarärag!’ nir”.
Nircurmi Jesusga soldäducuna mandag runata “Yupachicamangaynuy ruracächun, wayiquita aywacuy” nirun. Chauraga chayüram chay gueshyagnin cuticasha.
Pedropa suydranta Jesús cuticächingan
Chaypita Jesusga Pedropa wayintam aywacun. Chaychrümi tarirun Pedropa suydranta alisca acachaywan gueshyayar cämachru jitarayagta.
Jinarcurmi chay warmipa maquinta Jesús yatayuptilan chay gueshyapitaga cuticarun. Chaura warmiga pasay-pacha sharcurcurmi micuy garachracuyta galacuyun.

Jinarcurmi nä pacha chacanayaptinga, Jesusman chrarärichimun Asyagpa munayninchru cayag achca runacunata. Chaura Jesusga juc piñapaylawanmi chay lutan espiritucunata gargorun runacunapita, jinaman lapan gueshyagcunatas cuticarachira.
Chaycunata rurara unay willacugnin Isaiaswan Dios rimachingan ruracänanpagmi. Payga cay niram:
Jesusga munan lapan shongonpa runacuna servipäcunantam
Chaura chay achca runacuna muyurapäcuptinmi Jesusga discïpuluncunata cay nin: “Acu pasashun wac chimpanman”.
Chay niyaptilanmi Moisés isquirbinganpita yachrachig juc runaga ashuyur Jesusta cay nin: “Yachrachig, maytas chaytas gamwanmi aywayta munayä”.
Niptinmi Jesusga cay nirun: “Shumag pinsiay. Atogcunapasi machraynin canmi jinaman pishgocunapasi gueshan canmi. Nätan noga jana pachapita shamusha runapagga manam canchu wayiläsi jamayunäpag”.
Niruptinmi waquin discïpuluncunapita jucga Jesusta cay nin: “Munayniyog tayta, gamwan purinanchipag naupataga taytärag wanuruchun. Payta enterraruptïmi ichaga purishun”.
Chay niruptin Jesusga cay ninmi: “Gamwanga purishun. Juchalachru wanushanuysi cayagcuna pay wanuptinga enterrapäcuchun” nin.
Jesús löcu tamyata amaynächingan
Chay nircurga büquimanmi Jesusga yaycurun, jina guepantam discïpuluncunas yaycarärin.
Jinarcurmi chay jatun gochrapa aywarcayaptin mayänipita alisca löcu tamya galacuyun. Chauraga alisca walyaptin yacuga altumancama sharcur nämi büquitas chapanayara. Nätan Jesusga punuyaram.
Chaura discïpuluncunaga ashuyurmi riccharärichin cay nir: “Munayniyog tayta, salvayärimay. Nämi talpuyanchi”.

Chaura Jesusga cay nirunmi: “Mana alila yupachicamag runacuna, ¿imanirtag alisca manchacararcayanqui?” nirga, sharcurcurmi piñaparun walyaytawan yacutaga. Chaura chayüram walyaysi yacusi amaynarun shumag.
Chaura discïpuluncuna chayta ricarurga pasay mayacasha niragmi cay ninacarärin: “¿Imannincagtag cay runaga cayan walyawan yacusi cäsucunanpagga?” nir.
Gadarachru ishcay runacunata Jesús cuticächingan

Chaura Gadara ningan gochra manyan chimpaman chrarärin. Jinarcurmi yargarärimun panteonpita Jesús taripäcug Asyagpa munayninchru cayag ishcay runacuna. Chay runacunaga alisca manchaymi capäcura. Chaymi mana pisi chay camiñupa puripäcugchu.
Chaypitam chay ishcay runacunaga gayachracuypanuy cay nirärin: “Diospa-mayin Jesús, ¿imatatag nogacunawan munayanqui? Manaragsi üra aypamuptilanchu aywaramunqui cayman cunchuchipäcamänaypag”.
Chay carcayanganpita mana alä caruchrümi achca cuchicunata michircayara.
Jinarcurmi chay lutan espiritucunaga Jesusta cay nirärin: “Nä cay runacunapita gargarcayämaptiquiga, yaycapäcushagnar wac cuchicunaman”.

Nipäcuptinmi Jesusga “Äri, yaycapäcuy” nin. Chaura chay runacunapita yargarärir, chay lutan espiritucunaga cuchicunamanmi yaycarärin. Jinarcurmi cuchicunaga lapan, waraupa jegarparärin gochraman. Chaychrümi lapan wanurärin shengaypa.
Chaura cuchi michigcunaga gueshpicurcanmi. Jinarcurmi marcaman nä chrarärirga willapäcarärira cuchicunapitas jinaman chay ishcay runacunapitas.
Chauraga lapan runacunam aywayta galacayärimun Jesús cayanganman. Jinarcurmi paycagman chrarärirga “Aywacuynar cay Gadarapita” nirärin.
